stage_criteria.discovery: At least one validated supporting signal is linked.
stage_criteria.validation: At least two validated supporting signals from two or more independent sources are linked.
stage_criteria.emergence: Validation criteria, plus at least one validated company-level supporting signal, at least one recorded confirmation condition, and validated supporting evidence on structural demand (industrial production, exports, capacity utilisation) or company execution (reported company results).
stage_criteria.investable_review: Emergence criteria, plus a complete analyst scenario set (probabilities total 100%) and at least one analyst valuation for a linked company.

opportunities.title: Telecom: institutional capital broadening across the sector
opportunities.thesis: Starter hypothesis to test: domestic fund houses, foreign portfolio investors and institutional holders moved into Indian telecom at the same time in the latest periods. The hypothesis is that this reflects a durable change in how institutions view the sector's economics, not a one-period rotation. Industry economics (tariffs, capex intensity, return on capital) are not yet assessed.

opportunities.title: Power: improving credit quality of rated borrowers
opportunities.thesis: Starter hypothesis to test: two rating agencies, independently, upgraded far more Indian power borrowers than they downgraded over the last 90 days. The hypothesis is that the sector's cash-flow quality is improving (payment discipline, contracted renewables, lower leverage). Foreign portfolio investors were net sellers over the same period, so equity investors and credit analysts currently disagree.

companies.note: Company-level signal: institutional holding up 7.42 pp in the quarter to Sep-2026.
Company-level signal: institutional holding down 4.01 pp in the quarter to Sep-2026.

confirmation_conditions: Upgrades keep exceeding downgrades for power borrowers at India Ratings and ICRA in the next 90-day window.
CARE and CRISIL power-sector actions point the same way once enough are classified.
invalidation_conditions: Downgrades exceed upgrades for power borrowers at either agency over a 90-day window.
Defaults appear among rated power borrowers.
open_questions: Is the upgrade wave concentrated in renewables or distribution?
Why are FPIs net sellers while ratings improve?

opportunities.title: Information technology: institutional money returning
opportunities.thesis: Starter hypothesis to test: foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutions both raised exposure to Indian IT companies in the latest periods, after earlier outflows. The hypothesis is that institutions expect demand for Indian IT services to recover. Revenue, deal wins and margins are not yet ingested, so the demand side is untested.
